english.notes: Italian-taught Laurea in Informatica (33503). The international page: 'Non-EU applicants requiring a visa must have at least a certified B2 level of proficiency in Italian.' (https://www.uniroma1.it/en/pagina/applying-sapienza-international-student).

value.description: Admission test (TOLC-I, 'Prova di ammissione'); no grade threshold on the school record.

gpa.notes: Threshold is a test (TOLC-I per the 2026-27 L-31 call; below 18/50 an OFA is assigned).

deadline.quote: Pre-enrolment applications must be finalized and submitted by June 30, 2026, at 23:59 (Italian time)
deadline.notes: Only the 2026 cycle is published (a.y. 2026/2027): Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline for non-EU students residing abroad. Restricted-access courses also need a place in the course's own call ranking.

value.population: students filing income tax returns abroad (foreign income), fixed contribution by country band A/B/C

tuition.quote: Countries in Band A Total €300 First instalment €90 Second instalment €105 Third instalment €105 Countries in Band B Total €700 First instalment €210 Second instalment €245 Third instalment €245 Countries in Band C Total €1500
tuition.notes: Art. 38(2): fixed yearly contribution for foreign income, by country band (A €300, B €700, C €1500); the band depends on the country list on the same page, so this is a band, not one figure. The tuition page frames it under 'Benefits and exemptions – Academic year 2026/2027'. Standard (ISEE-less) Italian-income rate for the Faculty of Information Engineering, Computer Science and Statistics: Total €2,924. 2027/28 not published.

scholarship_exists.quote: Disco Lazio—the Ente Regionale per il Diritto allo Studio e alla Conoscenza—is the regional agency in charge of scholarships and housing assignments.
scholarship_exists.notes: Competitive selection ('you must apply through a competitive selection process'); the 'Borsista Disco' benefit at Sapienza reduces the fee to €30 + regional tax + stamp duty (Art. 49). Need-based, run by DiSCo Lazio.

scholarship_international.notes: No Sapienza page read states that Disco Lazio bachelor scholarships are open to non-EU students; the DiSCo Lazio call itself (laziodisco.it) is not an official Sapienza domain and was not read.
